#WATCH | ✈️🌍 Where did India travel in 2025? Short answer: Everywhere.

Vietnam emerged as the breakout star with a 133% jump in traffic, while OG favourites—Phuket, Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur—still ruled wishlists.
Closer home, Varanasi & Andamans saw ~20% growth, with UP the most visited state.

But the real shift? Indians travelled wider & deeper—from Ziro, Pasighat, Jagdalpur to solo escapes led by Delhi & Bengaluru.
New Year plans went global & personal—from yacht parties in the Philippines to Arctic saunas in Finland.

Driven by Gen Z (travel up 650%), India didn’t just travel more in 2025—
👉 It travelled further, younger & more personal. 🌏✨

#Varanasi #Indian #Delhi #NewYear @maryamf_writes
